product_summary: Website sourcetechnologi.com (Bengaluru, phone +91 80 26571838, email sourceblr@sourcetechnologi.in) is an electronic-component catalogue/distribution site. Real product lines listed in the site navigation: discrete semiconductors (diodes & rectifiers, thyristors, transistors, discrete semiconductor modules); embedded processors & controllers (CPLD, CPU/MPU, DSP, FPGA, MCU, SoC, SPLD); integrated circuits (amplifiers, audio ICs, chipsets, clock/timer, data converters, interface, logic, memory ICs, optocouplers, power management ICs, wireless & RF ICs); memory ICs (DRAM, EEPROM, eMMC, EPROM, FIFO, F-RAM, NAND/NOR flash, SRAM, UFS, memory modules/cards); circuit protection (TVS/ESD diodes, fuses, fuse holders, GDT, PPTC resettable fuses, SPD, thermistors, varistors); connectors (board-to-board, circular, D-Sub, FFC/FPC, fiber optic, headers & wire housings, IC sockets, USB, RF interconnects, terminal blocks, wire & cable); electromechanical (relays, contactors, solenoids, switches, encoders, motors & drives); passive components (capacitors, resistors, inductors, ferrites, EMI filters, frequency control/timing devices, potentiometers, transformers); power (AC/DC converters, power supplies, batteries, battery chargers, supercapacitors, solar panels/cells); optoelectronics (LEDs, LED lighting, displays, lasers, optical sensors); sensors (current, pressure, flow, magnetic, optical, proximity, environmental, force/load cells); RF & wireless modules; industrial automation and test & measurement items. Site banner states 'Now we are authorized SAMTEC' (authorized distributor claim for Samtec connectors).
comment: Declared HS 854159 is not a valid HS-6 subheading in the 8541 group as written (8541.5x covers only 8541.51/8541.59 for semiconductor-based transducers; 8541.59 exists, so the declared code is at best a single narrow line). The catalogue is overwhelmingly populated by parts that fall under 8541.10 (diodes, not photosensitive), 8541.21/8541.29 (transistors), 8541.30 (thyristors/triacs), 8541.41/8541.49 (LEDs, photosensitive devices), 8542.31/8542.32/8542.33/8542.39 (ICs: processors/controllers, memories, amplifiers, other ICs), plus 8532.24/8533.21/8533.39/8533.40 (capacitors, resistors, thermistors/varistors), 8536.50/8536.69/8536.90 (switches, connectors, terminals), 8544.42/8544.70 (cables, optical fibre cables), 8504.40/8504.31 (converters, transformers), 8543.70, 8473.30 (computer parts), 9025.80/9031.80 (sensors/instruments). So the declared 854159 covers only a sliver of the actual range: match_status = partial, and the code should be corrected/expanded to the list above rather than the company being rejected (per Rule 3). Industry label 'IT и электроника' is broadly consistent with the catalogue but understates that this is a passive/active component and connector distributor, not an IT services or finished-electronics maker. Trader signs: the site is a multi-brand catalogue with an explicit 'authorized SAMTEC' distributor banner and no manufacturing/factory/plant page found; product naming follows manufacturer part-number taxonomy (e.g. Samtec-style connector families), which is characteristic of a distributor/trader rather than a producer. Product lines missing from the declaration: connectors, passive components, power supplies/converters, cables, optoelectronics/LED lighting, sensors, industrial automation and test & measurement items — none of these are covered by 8541.59. All product data above is taken from the company's own website navigation/catalogue (sourcetechnologi.com, Home and About Us pages) and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, invoice or shipment record was reviewed in this HS-only pass, and no registry/revenue/customs research was performed per scope. Note: the legal name 'SOURCE TECHNOLOGI' and PAN AAYFS2133C were not independently corroborated here (out of scope); the website domain and email use the spelling 'sourcetechnologi', consistent with the claimed name.
